sentences.en: "They are not asleep yet," muttered the witch to herself.
sentences.zh: “他们还没有睡着呢，”女巫自言自语地说。

sentences.en: Jose muttered the answer to the question asked by the teacher.
sentences.zh: 何塞含糊地回答了老师提出的问题。

sentences.en: He lowered his head and muttered something to himself.
sentences.zh: 他低下了头，自己咕哝了一句。

senses.zh: 咕哝；抱怨地说；低声含糊地说
